_comment: Marketing BvA dashboard config. Scope = Dept 75 (all accounts) UNION Advertising accounts (any dept). Built 2026-06-09 by Claude Code for Chandler Harris. Sub-sections are regions; the top-level Marketing tab (no sub-section) renders the Channel x Region Summary matrix (Excel 'Total Marketing Spend Review' replica).

account_routing._comment: Include all marketing spend (OPEX + advertising) per Chandler. margin_prefixes pushes Revenue/COGS OUT of the per-region expense BvA grid (revenue is shown separately as the % -of-revenue denominator on the Summary matrix). exclude_categories hides the Revenue line from the expense grid only.
